changes: Extended B-2941's two-pass smoke retry with an OPT-IN `retryOnAnyFailure` manifest flag in run-all-smokes.ts: pass 2 now also retries a FAIL (not only a TIMEOUT) but ONLY for smokes explicitly flagged. Flagged 4 verified load-flake smokes (field-regression-cli, verification-freshness, worktree-repair, review-pass-discard) in smoke-manifest.json. Added 3 self-smoke cases (a/b/c) and CHANGELOG + docs/dev/test-coverage.md retry-policy note.
usage: In smoke-manifest.json set `retryOnAnyFailure: true` ONLY on a smoke that is serial-PASS but intermittently FAILs under parallel load. `npm run test:all` then retries its FAIL serially in pass 2; every unflagged smoke keeps FAIL=terminal. `npm run test:all -- --no-retry` disables pass 2 entirely (CI strict).
expectedOutcome: A flagged load-flake smoke that FAILs under parallel load is retried serially and passes (Final 1/1, exit 0); an UNFLAGGED FAIL stays terminal (exit 1, no retry); a flagged smoke that FAILs BOTH passes still ends terminal (Final 0/1, exit 1). Build clean, self-smoke 16/16.
actualTranscript: node packages/main/dist/tasks/run-all-smokes-smoke.js -> '16/16 checks passed' exit 0, incl B-348d (a) Final 1/1 exit 0, (b) terminal exit 1 no 'retrying serially', (c) Final 0/1 exit 1. outcomeDiff: No diff — expected and actual match exactly: 16/16 self-smoke, all 16 intents covered/pass, 4 smokes flagged, FAIL=terminal default preserved for all others (anti-masking proven by cases b and c).
limitations: Documented STOPGAP. Does not fix the shared-state root cause (why those 4 smokes FAIL rather than merely slow under heavy parallel worker-pool contention) — that remains a deferred follow-up. The allowlist is a manual, audited list; adding a smoke requires re-confirming it is serial-PASS first.
pitfalls: Never flag a smoke that is NOT verified serial-PASS — doing so would mask a genuine regression. The flag retries FAIL only; a flagged smoke failing BOTH passes is still a hard FAIL (case c proves this). --no-retry bypasses the whole mechanism. The allowlist must stay small and each entry re-verified serial-stable.
